# TASK-003 Spec Context

- Context-SHA256: `a19e300631d20d7a00f430977ac899b727f4a1fb48672072e351acfe6eddd70a`

## Required Rules
- `backend-code-quality-performance#RULE-backend-quality-001`: Backend changes must handle errors explicitly, bound remote/runtime calls with context deadlines, and keep `go vet` / `go test` green for touched packages when run in the project validators.
  - rule_sha256=6e013de6a3b7102799cea846e67c5c439ff3e68229e22feb883b48ebe15093c2 verifier=backend-code-quality-performance#RULE-backend-quality-001; artifacts=session-cancel.backend.design.md,session-cancel.md
- `backend-directory-structure#RULE-backend-directory-001`: Console backend code must live under `console/backend/` with `cmd/` entrypoints and `internal/` packages; handlers must not own persistence or runtime-driver details.
  - rule_sha256=bf6ffac46356c602f4de1f6df416c9777ce01dee32f8393de89682dcddc19422 verifier=backend-directory-structure#RULE-backend-directory-001; artifacts=session-cancel.backend.design.md,session-cancel.md
- `backend-database#RULE-backend-database-001`: All SQL must be parameterized and confined to `internal/repo` (or explicit migration helpers); schema changes must be idempotent or versioned and must not destroy user data silently.
  - rule_sha256=271a8d50f306d28f18a4c75db949f3d3dbe8cfbbef330dfbf14e34752a361d79 verifier=backend-database#RULE-backend-database-001; artifacts=none
- `backend-database#RULE-backend-no-select-star-001`: Queries must list explicit columns; do not use `SELECT *` in production SQL.
  - rule_sha256=e79cf84dfe56ac5ae802934859989b84698af26407b1619a44285cccff7464b3 verifier=backend-database#RULE-backend-no-select-star-001; artifacts=none
